question: Please examine our database records for Chinese cities (country_code_2 = 'cn') during July 2021 and identify both the shortest and longest streaks of consecutive date entries. For each date in these streaks, return exactly one record per date along with the corresponding city name. In your output, please ensure the first letter of each city name is capitalized and the rest are lowercase. Display the dates and city names for both the shortest and longest consecutive date streaks, ordered by date.
sql:
WITH cn_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS date_val
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn'
    AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01'
    AND insert_date <= '2021-07-31'
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT date_val,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY date_val) AS rn
  FROM cn_dates
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT date_val, date_val - CAST(rn AS INTEGER) AS streak_id
  FROM numbered
),
streak_summary AS (
  SELECT streak_id, COUNT(*) AS streak_length
  FROM streaks
  GROUP BY streak_id
  ORDER BY streak_length
  LIMIT 1
),
longest_streak_summary AS (
  SELECT streak_id, COUNT(*) AS streak_length
  FROM streaks
  GROUP BY streak_id
  ORDER BY streak_length DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
shortest_dates AS (
  SELECT s.date_val
  FROM streaks s
  JOIN streak_summary ss ON s.streak_id = ss.streak_id
),
longest_dates AS (
  SELECT s.date_val
  FROM streaks s
  JOIN longest_streak_summary ls ON s.streak_id = ls.streak_id
),
shortest_records AS (
  SELECT concat(upper(left(c.city_name, 1)), lower(substring(c.city_name, 2))) AS city_name, CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) AS date_val
  FROM cities c
  JOIN shortest_dates sd ON CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) = sd.date_val
  WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'cn'
),
longest_records AS (
  SELECT concat(upper(left(c.city_name, 1)), lower(substring(c.city_name, 2))) AS city_name, CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) AS date_val
  FROM cities c
  JOIN longest_dates ld ON CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) = ld.date_val
  WHERE c.country_code_2 = 'cn'
)
SELECT date_val, city_name FROM shortest_records
UNION ALL
SELECT date_val, city_name FROM longest_records
ORDER BY date_val, city_name
